text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 25. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have high school certificate or will high school certificate by September 2015. 4.Candidates with IELTS overall score of 6.5 or above with sub-score of 6.0 or above ; or overall score of 93 or above at Internet-based TOEFL with sub-score of 22 or above will be considered with preference Grade C or better in English Language at GCSE / GCEO Grade C or better in English First Language at IGCSE Grade B or better in English Second Language at IGCSE An overall band of 6.5 or better in Academic IELTS
